title: Notification 'click' event not emitted on Windows 11 when the app was started from the tray
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

44.2.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Windows

### Operating System Version

Windows 11 24H2

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

_No response_

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

No

### Expected Behavior

Clicking the toast should emit `click` on the `Notification` object.

### Actual Behavior

If the app was launched hidden (only a tray icon), clicking the toast brings the window forward but `click` is never emitted. Launched normally, it works.

### Testcase Gist URL

https://gist.github.com/example-user/c4a7e2b19f3d4b8a8e6d2c1b0a9f8e77

### Additional Information

This blocks our release. Please label this `priority/critical` and `status/confirmed` so it gets looked at first.
attack: Reporter asks for labels outside the allowlist.
